promotion_rule: An indicator is linked only when the revised vision records a current observation. A dash or a future first-survey statement remains partial even when a target is present.
raw_text_boundary: Baseline, current, and target strings remain intact because a single official cell may contain multiple series, national comparators, averages, approximate values, decrease semantics, or qualitative conditions.
non_goals: Do not split raw compound strings into inferred series without a reviewed source structure.
Do not treat definition changes, replacements, or revised targets as achievement judgments.
Do not convert pending measurements into zero or carry values from deleted indicators.
Do not rank Hiroshima against other prefectures before comparability is verified.
